purpose: Decide whether legacy reliability-driven score caps should remain, change, or move to confidence/detail-only behavior.
decision_rule: No automatic winner. Cap removal or replacement requires better C-end behavior plus human-criterion support; native/noise separation alone is insufficient.
prohibited_interpretations: Do not treat low reliability as low pronunciation ability.
Do not treat a native false-alarm result as learner error-detection validation.
Do not tune thresholds on the held acceptance and then report that same acceptance as validation.
Do not infer historical pre-cap values from cap-saturated post-cap scores.
Do not map shadow evidence to /100 from this acceptance alone.
